subject.title: [Bug]: Session event broadcasts rebuild full gateway session rows

question: Should maintainers continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86793 as the fix path for this issue, require a repaired/rebased version with runtime proof, or replace it with a fresh implementation?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible on current main, but the linked PR carries session-state contract risk and missing live proof, so an automated new fix PR would compete with existing unresolved work.

options.title: Repair and prove the linked PR
options.body: Rebase the linked PR onto current main, preserve scoped row-loading behavior, and require redacted gateway or Control UI runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Replace with a fresh fix
options.body: Close or pause the linked PR only if maintainers prefer a new implementation that keeps the same lightweight snapshot goal with clearer proof.

options.title: Wait for fresh profiling
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer implementation if maintainers want current profiler evidence after adjacent hot-path fixes before accepting another session-event mode.

recommendation.title: Repair and prove the linked PR
recommendation.body: Rebase the linked PR onto current main, preserve scoped row-loading behavior, and require redacted gateway or Control UI runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared session event projection work makes this the best available routing candidate for the event payload contract choice.
